name: TextSelectionToolbar
description: The toolbar that floats over selected text, with actions such as Quote, Copy and Comment: in a message, in an Artifact, anywhere text can be selected. Place it with `createTextSelectionAnchor` in a Popover.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: If `true`, using keyboard navigation will wrap focus to the other end of the toolbar once the end is reached.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: TextSelectionToolbarButton
description: One action on the selected text: a 28px button with a 16px icon and a Title Case label that never wraps.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: When `true` the item remains focusable when disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: TextSelectionToolbarSeparator
description: A 20px line between groups of actions in the toolbar.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the separator. Defaults to the opposite of the toolbar's orientation, so a horizontal toolbar renders vertical separators.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
